q: The soul is never born nor dies at any time. It has not come into being, does not come into being, and will not come into being. It is unborn, eternal, ever-existing, and primeval.
Let noble thoughts come to us from every side.
Truth alone triumphs.
a: Mundaka Upanishad — India's national motto (Satyameva Jayate)

q: The whole world is one family.
From the unreal, lead me to the real. From darkness, lead me to light. From death, lead me to immortality.
Even as a mirror stained by dust shines brilliantly when it has been cleaned, so the embodied soul, on seeing the nature of the Self, becomes unitary.
Know thyself and thou shalt know the universe.
The Self is not something that can be known by the mind — it is what allows the mind to know.
Three things cannot be long hidden: the sun, the moon, and the truth.
The mind is everything. What you think, you become.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.
In the sky, there is no distinction of east and west; people create distinctions out of their own minds and then believe them to be true.
Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
All that we are is the result of what we have thought. The mind is everything.
Hatred is never appeased by hatred in this world. By non-hatred alone is hatred appeased.
All breathing, existing, living, sentient creatures should not be slain, nor treated with violence, nor abused, nor tormented, nor driven away.
A man is seated on top of a tree in the midst of a burning forest. He sees all living beings perish. But he doesn't realize his own predicament.
Speak the truth, however bitter it may be.
The soul is its own friend and its own enemy.
The world's biggest power is the youth and beauty of a woman.
Learn from the mistakes of others. You can't live long enough to make them all yourself.
Education is the best friend. An educated person is respected everywhere. Education beats the beauty and the youth.
As soon as the fear approaches near, attack and destroy it.
The king shall lose no time when the opportunity arrives.
In the happiness of his subjects lies the king's happiness; in their welfare his welfare.
The biggest guru-mantra is: Never share your secrets with anybody. It will destroy you.
All people are my children. As for my own children, I desire that they may be provided with all welfare and happiness of this world and of the next.
There is no gift greater than the gift of the Dhamma.
King Piyadasi desires that all beings should be unhurt, self-controlled, calm in mind, and gentle.
I have had banyan trees planted on the roads to give shade to man and beast.
Whatever is beautiful is not always good, but whatever is good is always beautiful.
He who knows not and knows not he knows not — he is a fool, shun him. He who knows and knows not he knows — he is asleep, wake him.
A poem should be felt rather than merely heard.
Time respects not the form of the flower, but the fragrance carries on.
A king is not truly great unless he is greater than himself.
Whosoever casts down his glance when looking at my servants, I will confound his sight on the day of judgment.
a: Akbar's reported saying on religious tolerance

q: My heart is the throne of God; why should I bow to a mere stone?
If I were to build a monument to all who suffered and all who triumphed, it would look like Fatehpur Sikri.
Even if we are outnumbered, our forts are our strength.
Freedom is a boon which everyone has a right to receive.
Do not think about the weakness of the enemy — think about the strength of the motherland.
God has given me this country. I shall not allow it to be swallowed up.
Better to live one day as a lion than a thousand years as a sheep.
A brave man is never afraid to die, but he chooses when and how.
Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
First they ignore you, then they laugh at you, then they fight you, then you win.
The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
In a gentle way, you can shake the world.
Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
An eye for an eye will make the whole world blind.
The future depends on what you do today.
Non-violence is the greatest force at the disposal of mankind.
A nation's culture resides in the hearts and in the soul of its people.
The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.
Long years ago we made a tryst with destiny, and now the time comes when we shall redeem our pledge.
A moment comes, which comes but rarely in history, when we step out from the old to the new.
The discovery of India — what a phrase — and what a reality.
a: Jawaharlal Nehru, The Discovery of India

q: Citizenship consists in the service of the country.
Crises and deadlocks when they occur have at least this advantage, that they force us to think.
The policy of being too cautious is the greatest risk of all.
I measure the progress of a community by the degree of progress which women have achieved.
Lost rights are never regained by appeals to the conscience of the usurper, but by relentless struggle.
If I find the constitution being misused, I shall be the first to burn it.
Men are mortal. So are ideas. An idea needs propagation as much as a plant needs watering.
Life should be great rather than long.
Political power cannot be our ultimate goal. Political power is a means to the end.
They may kill me, but they cannot kill my ideas. They can crush my body, but they will not be able to crush my spirit.
Lovers, lunatics and poets are made of the same stuff.
Revolution does not necessarily involve sanguinary strife. It is not a cult of the bomb and the pistol.
My neck is ready. Your gallows await.
a: Bhagat Singh to the British court

q: Give me blood, and I will give you freedom.
It is our duty to pay for our liberty with our own blood.
Forget not that the greatest crime is to compromise with injustice.
Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high — let my country awake.
The butterfly counts not months but moments, and has time enough.
You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
Faith is the bird that feels the light and sings when the dawn is still dark.
If you cry because the sun has gone out of your life, your tears will prevent you from seeing the stars.
The highest education is that which does not merely give us information but makes our life in harmony with all existence.
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
You have to grow from the inside out. None can teach you, none can make you spiritual.
In a conflict between the heart and the brain, follow your heart.
All the powers in the universe are already ours. It is we who have put our hands before our eyes and cry that it is dark.
The world is the great gymnasium where we come to make ourselves strong.
Stand up, be bold, and take the whole responsibility on your own shoulders.
We are responsible for what we are, and whatever we wish ourselves to be, we have the power to make ourselves.
An equation for me has no meaning unless it expresses a thought of God.
I have not trodden through the conventional regular course which is followed in a university course.
a: Srinivasa Ramanujan, letter to G.H. Hardy

q: The Earth rotates on its own axis; the fixed stars do not move.
Dream, dream, dream. Dreams transform into thoughts and thoughts result in action.
Don't take rest after your first victory because if you fail in the second, more lips are waiting to say that your first victory was just luck.
You have to dream before your dreams can come true.
If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.
From Harappa to the Republic, India has never stopped becoming itself.
Every stone of every fort in India remembers a name history forgot.
The sea that carried Chola ships to Southeast Asia carried India's ideas further than its armies ever marched.
A throne is temporary, but a temple outlives every king who built it.
To read India's history is to read the story of how the wounded keep walking.
There is no nation on Earth that has survived as many endings and still calls itself young.
What the British called rebellion, history would later call the first cry for freedom.
Independence was not given. It was taken, slowly, by a million small refusals.
Unity in diversity has been India's secret of survival as long as her history is.
Every dynasty believes it is eternal — the ruins of Hampi and Vijayanagara disagree.
A nation built by a hundred different invasions is not weaker for it — it is stronger for having absorbed them all.
The river that carved the Indus Valley still flows somewhere in every Indian's memory.
It takes a moment to draw a border, and generations to heal what it divides.
Empires rise on ambition and fall on arrogance — India has watched both, many times.
Knowledge gives humility, humility gives worthiness, worthiness gives wealth.
The fragrance of flowers spreads only in the direction of the wind, but the goodness of a person spreads in all directions.
I shall not surrender my Jhansi.
a: Often attributed to Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi

q: What is the use of living if my country is enslaved?
I was born for a purpose and that purpose is freedom.
The stars do not ask permission of the night to shine.
I have searched within the secret chamber of my heart and I have seen, O servant, that he is everywhere.
My Lord is the support of my soul; without Him I cannot live.
